title: The Fullness Gauge & Levers
caption: Past ~half full, the model starts losing the plot.
prose: Below 50% is the smart zone. Above 50%, accuracy degrades. Above 75%, hallucination risk spikes. Three levers: Monitor, Compact, Hand off.

smart-zone-discipline.description: Keeping context windows under 50% capacity guarantees high accuracy and prevents silent prompt drift.
